reel.caption:
Does your UPI PIN ever receive money?

No. A UPI PIN only authorises a payment. It is never needed to receive money.
On 19 Oct the government's cyber-crime coordination centre warned of social media ads using deepfake videos of top leaders to promise welfare money, cashback or spin-and-win prizes.
Victims are then asked to pay "tax", "processing" or "registration" fees again and again, or to approve a collect request.
If money has already gone, call the 1930 cyber-fraud helpline at once: faster reporting improves the chance of freezing it.
